create_logistic_distribution: create a Logistic distribution with loc and scale parameters for probabilistic modeling
sample_from_logistic: sample random values from a Logistic distribution using a JAX PRNG key
compute_log_prob: compute the log probability of a value under a Logistic distribution
calculate_entropy: calculate the Shannon entropy in Nats for a Logistic distribution
evaluate_cdf: evaluate the cumulative distribution function of a Logistic distribution at a given value
